_about: TAP result-code registry. Machine-readable form of TAP-spec-v0.1.md §10 [TAP-RESULT-CODES]. Implementations MAY add namespaced codes as `x.<vendor>.<code>`; Verifiers MUST preserve unknown codes verbatim and MUST NOT coerce them to a known value. Codes marked "provisional" belong to §9.2 authority binding, which has no reference implementation yet — see CHANGELOG.md [0.1.3].
